findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_dental_practice_action · Public sink: start_dental_request, confirm_dental_request · Destructive: abandon_xona_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_dental_practice_action · Public sink: start_dental_request, confirm_dental_request · Destructive: abandon_xona_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
